chunks: Al-Kulayni said: A Shaykh from our companions, whose name I forgot, narrated that Abu Amr was asked by Ahmad ibn Ishaq about a matter similar to this, and he gave an answer similar to this. We have previously presented this narration in what preceded of the book.

key_terms.أَبُو عَمْرٍو: Abu Amr, a companion of the Imams
key_terms.أَحْمَدُ بْنُ إِسْحَاقٍ: Ahmad ibn Ishaq, a prominent companion and narrator
key_terms.شَيْخٌ: Shaykh, a respected scholar or companion

ai.seo_question: Who asked Abu Amr about the issue and what was the nature of his response according to Al-Kulayni?
ai.summary: Al-Kulayni cites an unnamed companion to validate the chain of transmission for Abu Amr’s response to Ahmad ibn Ishaq, reinforcing the reliability of this specific legal ruling within the context of the Occultation. By noting that this narration was previously recorded, the text emphasizes the continuity and consistency of the Special Emissaries' (al-Nuwwab al-Khass) authoritative guidance during the Imam's absence.
